# CopilotForge - Security and Privacy

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reviewer-class department that assesses identity, access, data exposure, connectors, privacy and retention for AI solutions and blocks release while material risks are unresolved.

- **Layer:** assurance (reviewer-class: may block)
- **Lead role:** Security and Privacy Reviewer
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-security-privacy`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`connector-review`](skills/connector-review/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Launch, Improve | Reviews the connectors, actions, tools, MCP servers and APIs an agent or automation uses, covering user versus maker authentication, least privilege, data policies, data leaving the tenant and confirmation for write actions, and classifies each finding as blocking or advisory with a fix. Use when an agent gains an action or tool, when a flow uses a new connector, or when a maker shares a connection. |
| [`data-exposure-review`](skills/data-exposure-review/SKILL.md) | draft | Assure, Launch, Improve | Reviews what content an AI solution can reach and reveal - oversharing, permissions, sensitivity labels, the agent's sharing scope, web and public knowledge, and where outputs travel - and classifies each finding as blocking or advisory with a fix. Use when an agent or Copilot rollout reaches its security gate, when a maker adds a large knowledge source, or when sensitive content surfaces in answers. |
| [`privacy-assessment`](skills/privacy-assessment/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Assure, Launch, Improve | Assesses personal data in an AI solution for lawful basis, purpose limitation, transparency, data minimisation, retention of prompts, responses and transcripts, DPIA screening under UK GDPR and ICO guidance, and people-related uses, classifying findings as blocking or advisory. Use when an agent or AI solution processes personal data, when transcripts are kept, or when AI outputs inform decisions about people. |
